messages:
mike: opened PR #5240 adding 'lightweight seed-relay' doc for private installs. includes a tiny systemd unit, container example, and curl fallback for constrained egress. preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5240

ci-bot: CI: docs build passed · preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5240 (build 9420)

ana: nice. please include curl example with `--retry 4 --fail --tlsv1.2` and a short sha256 check: `sha256sum -c /opt/seed/bundle.sha256`.

fern: KMS note: remind readers PKCS#11 socket paths vary (eg `/var/run/pkcs11.sock`, `/opt/hsm/pkcs11.sock`). add an env sample: `PKCS11_SOCKET=/var/run/pkcs11.sock`.

mike: added curl + checksum + PKCS11 env example. also a one-liner cleanup in systemd ExecStartPost to remove bundle after install.

docs-bot: Reminder: add `needs-legal` label if content crosses export/crypto policy.

mike: content is operational only; will ping legal for quick ack and add a sentence to follow local export rules. planning to merge after legal and green CI.

ana: small nit: anchor mismatch in checklist, will push a microfix to the branch.

fern: LGTM after that. thanks! :thumbsup:
